Full After Effects tutorial: a complete viral SaaS product animation from scratch. Depth reveal transition, animated UI panel, cursor interaction, exploding text and a 3D carousel.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro
0:23 Depth Reveal transition
1:04 Building the UI panel
4:47 UI Animation
6:57 Scene 2
9:11 Text Animation
9:48 Random shapes background
12:57 3D carousel

🧰 WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
- Depth reveal transition with an AI depth map
- Building a clean SaaS UI panel with shape layers
- Stroke icons — rounded caps, corners, proper scaling
- Typing and word-by-word text reveals with stagger
- Cursor animation that drives the button state
- Sharp easing graphs that make motion feel expensive
- A layered 3D-style carousel with real depth

Our website: https://solairmotion.com/
